battle.name: 第二次世界大戰
battle.brief: 1939年9月1日德軍越過波蘭邊境拉開戰幕，戰火六年橫掃歐洲、北非、亞洲與太平洋。德國空軍的制空主力梅塞施密特Bf 109戰鬥機是本場衝突的關鍵棋子：不列顛空戰中它與英格蘭皇家空軍逐日爭奪天空，巴巴羅薩、突尼斯與諾曼第上空亦不斷出動。

kit.name: 梅塞施密特Bf 109戰鬥機
kit.history: 做為納粹德國空軍的主力單座戰鬥機，Bf 109在歐洲戰場上肩負制空任務，與盟軍戰機交戰。

countries: 第二次世界大戰由兩大對立集團在歐洲、亞洲、非洲與太平洋同時拉開。軸心國一方以德國、意大利與日本為核心，匈牙利、羅馬尼亞、保加利亞、斯洛伐克、克羅地亞等國在不同的時間點先後加入；德國方面由最高統帥部與武裝力量最高指揮部統率全局，陸軍以師、團、營為基本編制，航空兵團則按戰鬥航空兵團、偵察航空兵團與轟炸航空兵團分科，艦隊按戰分艦隊、巡洋艦隊與驅逐艦隊分層，後勤與治安由後勤部隊與黨衛軍的武裝力量承擔。同盟國一方以英國、蘇聯、美國、中華民國與自由法國為骨幹，先後有三十餘國加入，先後成立歐洲盟軍最高統帥部、遠東委員會與太平洋戰區等指揮體系，皇家空軍以大隊與中隊作戰，皇家海軍按艦隊、戰區與突擊中隊編制。兩陣營真正的分野不在名單，而在於能否把工業產能、徵召兵員與後勤體系轉成持續作戰的能力，這條主軸貫穿了戰爭全程。
countriesEn: The Second World War was fought by two opposing blocs that were engaged at the same time across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Pacific. On the Axis side Germany, Italy and Japan formed the core, with Hungary, Romania, Bulgaria, Slovakia and Croatia joining at different moments. Germany was run through the Führer Headquarters and the Armed Forces High Command: the army was organised into divisions, regiments and battalions, the air force was split into fighter, reconnaissance and bomber wings, the navy into battle, cruiser and destroyer fleets, while logistics and security fell to the supply units and the armed formations of the SS. The Allied bloc was built around Britain, the Soviet Union, the United States, the Republic of China and Free France, with more than thirty further countries joining over time. It produced the Supreme Allied Commander in Europe, the Far Eastern Committee and the Pacific theatre commands, while the Royal Air Force fought in squadrons and wings and the Royal Navy in fleets, task forces and escort groups. The real dividing line between the two coalitions lay not in membership lists but in whether each could turn industrial output, conscripted manpower and a logistics system into the ability to keep fighting, and that single axis runs through the whole war.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨政治決策與戰術執行兩端。德國方面，希特勒以獨裁者身分主導整體戰略，早年以凡爾賽和約所帶來的民族屈辱為號召爭取軍費，1935年公開重整空軍，1941年6月發動巴巴羅薩行動，1943年2月下令全面動員，最終在柏林戰役末期自殺；戈林主持航空兵團的重建，戰鬥航空兵團的指揮官如加蘭德、莫爾德斯與馬賽勒在西班牙內戰與不列顛空戰中累積戰功，其中馬賽勒在兩百餘次出擊中取得約一百五十八次空戰勝利，1941年2月殉職；Fw 190與Me 262的問世同樣依靠德國航空工業在戰時的趕製與加班。蘇聯方面，史達林在1941年承受巴巴羅薩初期的重創之後重建軍隊，華西列夫斯基主持持續的戰役，朱可夫在史達林格勒與庫爾斯克把制空權與裝甲優勢結合起來。英美方面，邱吉爾主張不投降並以海峽與地中海的持久戰消耗德國，羅斯福以租借法案輸送物資並推動對日開戰，艾森豪威爾任歐洲盟軍最高統帥，休·道丁與基思·帕克在英格蘭指揮戰鬥機大隊，布魯門堡與蒙哥馬利先後接手地面部隊，德國的隆美爾在北非與諾曼第指揮裝甲集群，意大利的墨索里尼與日本的裕仁、東條英機則是另外兩位最高決策者。
peopleEn: The decisive figures sit at both ends of the chain, political decision and tactical execution. In Germany Adolf Hitler directed overall strategy as an outright dictator, drawing support from a sense of national humiliation left by the Treaty of Versailles, openly rebuilding the Luftwaffe from 1935, launching Operation Barbarossa in June 1941 and ordering total mobilisation in February 1943 before taking his own life at the end of the battle for Berlin. Hermann Göring presided over the rebuild of the air arm, and wing commanders such as Adolf Galland, Werner Mölders and Hans-Joachim Marseille built their reputations in the Spanish Civil War and the Battle of Britain; Marseille alone is credited with roughly one hundred and fifty-eight aerial victories in more than two hundred sorties and was killed in action in February 1941. The introduction of the Fw 190 and the Me 262 the Fw 190 and the Me 262 likewise existed only because the German aircraft industry worked round the clock to bring them into production. In the Soviet Union Stalin rebuilt the army after the shock of the opening of Barbarossa, with Vasilevsky running the continuous series of operations and Zhukov combining air superiority with armoured mass at Stalingrad and Kursk. In Britain and the United States Churchill refused to negotiate and wore Germany down in a war of attrition around the Channel and the Mediterranean, Roosevelt supplied the Allies through the Lend-Lease Act and pushed the United States into the war with Japan, Eisenhower took command of the Allied armies in Europe, Hugh Dowding and Keith Park commanded the fighter groups in England, Montgomery and von Manstein ran the ground war in turn, Rommel led the armoured formations in North Africa and Normandy, and Mussolini, the Emperor Hirohito and Hideki Tojo were the other two supreme decision-makers of the Axis.
kits: 卡面上那架梅塞施密特Bf 109戰鬥機是德國空軍整場戰爭的制空骨幹。1935年5月完成首飛，1936年正式進入德國航空兵序列，機體為半下單翼、矩形翼與窄身體，裝戴戴姆勒－賓士DB 601或DB 605十二缸液冷倒V型引擎，最大速度約五百七十公里每小時；早期型掛一門MG 151/20二十毫米機炮與兩挺MG 17七點九二毫米機槍，E型後期改為三門二十毫米機炮加一挺七點九二毫米機槍，炸彈掛架可攜帶炸彈與火箭。各型態合計產量約三萬四千架，是二戰產量最大的單座戰鬥機之一。與它搭配的是福克沃克Fw 190戰鬥機、亨舍爾Hs 129座艙俯衝轟炸機、Ju 88轟炸機與道爾多夫Do 17偵察機，戰爭末期又加入Me 262噴氣戰鬥機與Me 163火箭截擊機。同一場戰爭的另一端是Supermarine Spitfire、Hawker Hurricane、de Havilland Mosquito夜間戰鬥機，以及P-51 Mustang、P-38 Lightning、B-24 Liberator、Yakovlev Yak-1、Polikarpov I-16與MiG-3。地面方面有德國的Panzer III、四號與五號坦克、虎式、88毫米高射砲與突擊砲，盟軍的Sherman、Cromwell與T-34；海上有VII型U型潛艇、Scharnhorst與Tirpitz戰列艦、各型護衛艦與潛航補給艦；運輸依靠Ju 52三引擎機、C-47 Skytrain與卡車，役馬仍留在警戒與後勤崗位上。
kitsEn: The Messerschmitt Bf 109 on the card face was the backbone of the German air force for the entire war. It first flew in May 1935 and entered Luftwaffe service in 1936, with a semi-low-wing, rectangular-wing, narrow-fuselage layout powered by the liquid-cooled inverted V twelve-cylinder Daimler-Benz DB 601 or DB 605, reaching a maximum speed of roughly five hundred and seventy kilometres per hour. Early versions carried one 20 mm MG 151/20 cannon and two 7.92 mm MG 17 machine guns, while later E-series aircraft mounted four cannon, and the bomb racks could carry bombs and rockets. Something like thirty-four thousand were built across all variants, making it one of the largest-produced single-seat fighters of the war. Working alongside it were the Focke-Wulf Fw 190, the Henschel Hs 129 dive bomber, the Ju 88 and the Dornier Do 17 reconnaissance aircraft, with the Me 262 jet fighter and the Me 163 rocket interceptor joining late in the war. On the other side of the same conflict flew the Supermarine Spitfire, the Hawker Hurricane, the de Havilland Mosquito night fighter, and in the American and Soviet inventories the P-51 Mustang, P-38 Lightning, B-24 Liberator, Yakovlev Yak-1, Polikarpov I-16 and Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-3. On the ground stood the German Panzer III, Panzer IV, Panzer V, Tiger, 88 mm anti-aircraft guns and assault guns, opposed by the Sherman, Cromwell and T-34. At sea the VII-type U-boats, the battle cruisers Scharnhorst and Tirpitz, escort vessels and submarine supply ships carried the blockade, while transport rested on the three-engined Ju 52, the C-47 Skytrain and long columns of trucks, with draft horses still holding guard and supply duties.
tactics: 空中戰術是這場大戰的核心課題。開戰初期，德國以俯衝式Ju 87與Bf 109協同的閃電戰聞名：戰鬥機在一定高度巡邏，掩護俯衝轟炸機對防空薄弱、空軍基地密集的目標實施低空襲擊，再由俯衝戰鬥機在返程中低空追擊撤退中的敵機。不列顛空戰期間，皇家空軍採用道丁提出的指揮所戰鬥與雷達導引截擊，以地面觀察哨與過來厄系統整合情報；德方則集中出動戰鬥航空兵團縱隊，嘗試在海岸線上實施超越攻擊，但戰機航程不足迫使它們冒險降落基地，1940年9月進攻遂告中止。1941年後，英美夜間戰鬥機的攔截成為德機在英吉利海峽上空的重大損失來源，德方隨後改為以Bf 109與Fw 190雙機編隊護衛Fw 190夜間偷襲，1943年更成立突擊航空兵團，以密集編隊投入空戰，用數量與射擊紀律換取局部優勢。地面方面則是速度與突然性的競賽：德國裝甲集群在空地協同下直插縱深，蘇軍以縱深射擊與絕對制空權反擊，1944年盟軍在諾曼第先鞏固灘頭再向內陸擴張，海上德軍以潛艇群狼戰術在北大西洋切斷英國航運。
tacticsEn: Air fighting was the central tactical problem of this war. At the start, Germany's blitzkrieg was built on the cooperation of the Ju 87 dive bomber with the Bf 109: fighters patrolled at altitude, shielded dive bombers attacking airfields with thin defences and dense concentrations of aircraft, and dive fighters chased retreating opponents low over the ground on the way home. During the Battle of Britain the Royal Air Force fought with Dowding's command-controlled system and radar vectored interception, tying together observation posts and the Chain Home chain; Germany responded by committing fighter groups in mass, attempting attacks in depth along the coast, but the limited range of its fighters forced them to risk landing back on their own fields, and the offensive was called off in September 1940. After 1941 interception by British and American night fighters became the largest single source of German aircraft losses over the English Channel, and the Luftwaffe switched to pairing Bf 109s with Fw 190s to escort night raids, then formed the Jagdverbände in 1943, flying dense formations that traded numbers and gun discipline for local superiority. On the ground the contest was one of speed and surprise: German armoured groups struck deep in close cooperation with the air force, the Soviet answer was depth fire backed by air superiority, the Allies in Normandy consolidated their beachhead before driving inland, and in the Atlantic the U-boats hunted in wolfpack formations against British shipping.
data: 可核對的數字集中在兵力、產量與軍人傷亡三方面。戰爭自1939年9月1日開打，到1945年9月2日日本簽署降書，歷時約2,192天，參與的國家與地區超過五十個。死亡人數的估算分歧頗大，其中軍人死亡約二千萬；德國最終損失軍事人員約五百三十萬，蘇聯的軍事人員損失約八百七十萬，是交戰國中最重者。飛機方面，Bf 109各型態合計產量約三萬四千架，戰時損失約五千架，其中相當一部分是飛行事故與訓練損失，1941年後英美夜間戰鬥機的截擊則是主要的戰鬥損失來源；不列顛空戰一役，德國空軍損失飛機1,887架，英國皇家空軍損失1,023架。1944年6月諾曼第登陸時，盟軍首批上岸兵力約十三萬人，投入艦艇逾四千艘，飛機逾一萬架；同年6月至8月的白俄羅斯戰役中，蘇軍投入兵力約二百四十萬。巴巴羅薩行動德軍首戰投入兵員約三百萬至三百八十萬，東線沿線長達兩千公里以上。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around three areas: manpower, production and military losses. The war ran from 1 September 1939 to the Japanese instrument of surrender on 2 September 1945, a span of roughly 2,192 days, and involved more than fifty states and territories. Estimates of the dead differ sharply, but military deaths are usually put at about twenty million; Germany finally lost some five million three hundred thousand military personnel and the Soviet Union some eight million seven hundred thousand, the heaviest military losses of any belligerent. On the aircraft side the Bf 109 reached a total of about thirty-four thousand across all variants and lost roughly five thousand, a substantial share of them in flying accidents and training, with interception by British and American night fighters after 1941 accounting for most combat losses; in the Battle of Britain alone the Luftwaffe lost 1,887 aircraft against 1,023 for the Royal Air Force. At the Normandy landings of June 1944 the Allies put roughly one hundred and thirty thousand men ashore first, with more than four thousand ships and ten thousand aircraft committed; in the Soviet offensive of June to August 1944 in Belorussia, about two million four hundred thousand troops took part. Germany committed between three million and three million eight hundred thousand men to the opening of Barbarossa, along a front extending more than two thousand kilometres.
cause: 戰爭的起因是多條不滿同時匯聚。1929年華爾街崩潰引發的經濟大蕭條，使德國與意大利的政權轉向擴張與軍事化；凡爾賽和約對德國的剝奪，加上德國東部的失地與少數民族問題，使領土要求與泛德民族主義擁有廣泛的社會基礎。德國在1933年後陸續重整軍備，1935年3月宣布不再受凡爾賽條約限制並公開擴充空軍，1936年3月進入萊茵蘭，1938年3月吞併奧地利，同年9月依慕尼黑協定取得蘇台德，1939年3月佔領捷克斯洛伐克。英法推行姑息並試圖以德國制衡蘇聯，蘇德在1939年8月簽訂互不侵犯條約，暫時解決了柏林的東線顧慮；9月1日德軍進攻波蘭後，英法於9月3日宣戰，戰爭全面展開。其後蘇德條約失效，1941年6月22日德軍發動巴巴羅薩行動；同年12月7日日本偷襲珍珠港，美國與其後數十國對日宣戰，戰爭自此成為真正的全球衝突。
causeEn: The war grew out of several discontents converging at once. The economic depression that followed the Wall Street crash of 1929 pushed the governments of Germany and Italy towards expansion and militarisation; the territorial deductions imposed on Germany by the Treaty of Versailles, together with the lost eastern territories and the minority populations left behind them, gave revanchism and pan-German nationalism a wide social base. After 1933 Germany rearmed steadily, declaring on March 1935 that it would no longer observe the limits of Versailles and openly expanding the Luftwaffe, reoccupying the Rhineland in March 1936, taking over Austria in March 1938, acquiring the Sudetenland under the Munich Agreement that September, and occupying Czechoslovakia in March 1939. Britain and France followed a policy of appeasement and hoped to use Germany as a counterweight against the Soviet Union, while the German-Soviet Non-Aggression Pact of August 1939 removed Berlin's eastern anxiety for the time being. After the German attack on Poland on 1 September, Britain and France declared war on the 3rd and the conflict became general. The pact then broke down and Germany opened the Barbarossa offensive on 22 June 1941; on 7 December Japan struck Pearl Harbor, the United States and several dozen other states declared war, and the war became global in the fullest sense.
impact: 戰爭的後果遠超戰場本身。制度上，1945年10月24日美、蘇、中、英、法五國成立聯合國並同為安全理事會常任理事國，聯合國憲章與世界人權宣言把人權與民族自決寫成國際規範。歐洲方面，戰敗的德國與日本被盟軍佔領，兩國分別由盟國佔領當局接管，並在紐倫堡與東京的戰爭罪行審判中接受法律制裁；戰後歐洲大陸在馬歇爾計劃推動下走向煤鋼聯營與歐洲煤鋼共同體，為日後的歐洲一體化打下基礎。殖民體系在戰爭中被削弱，亞洲與非洲的民族解放運動在戰後迅速發展，中華民國成為安理會常任理事國之一，美蘇勢力取而代之，冷戰格局就此取代歐洲列強的全球優勢。軍事技術上，噴氣式戰鬥機、火箭截擊機、雷達導引與航空母艦編隊的運用都在此役成熟，像Bf 109這樣以手操生氣力換取極限性能的設計，最終被速度更快、裝備更重的下一代戰鬥機取代。
impactEn: The consequences of the war reached far beyond the battlefield. Institutionally, the United States, the Soviet Union, China, Britain and France founded the United Nations on 24 October 1945 and took permanent seats on the Security Council, while the Charter and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights turned human rights and national self-determination into international norms. In Europe the defeated Germany and Japan were placed under Allied occupation and administered by the respective occupation authorities, answering to the war crimes trials at Nuremberg and Tokyo; the continental economy was then pushed by the Marshall Plan towards coal and steel integration and the European Coal and Steel Community, laying the groundwork for later European integration. The colonial system was weakened, and the national liberation movements of Asia and Africa accelerated after the war, with the Republic of China taking a permanent seat on the Security Council and American and Soviet influence replacing that of the European powers, so that the Cold War order replaced the old European world system. Technologically, jet fighters, rocket interceptors, radar vectoring and carrier task force operations all matured in this conflict, and designs like the Bf 109, which bought its extreme performance at the price of heavy control loads, were ultimately superseded by the faster and heavier armed next generation of fighters.
result: 結果是軸心國的全面失敗與一套戰後新秩序的成形。歐洲方面，1944年6月起的諾曼第與南法登陸開闢第二條戰線，1944年8月蘇軍越過東線進入波羅的海沿岸，1945年2月自維斯瓦河至奧得河的戰役中突破德軍中央集團軍群正面戰線，3月抵達易北河，4月強渡奧得河進入柏林；希特勒於4月30日在總統府地下室自殺，5月8日德國在雷伊格斯霍爾德無條件投降，隨後由美、蘇、英、法分區佔領。亞洲與太平洋方面，1942年6月中途島海戰與同年8月瓜達康納爾島的失利標誌日本攻勢的頂點，1943年後美軍在緬甸、索羅門與馬里亞納逐線收復失地，1945年8月美國分別向廣島與長崎投下原子彈，蘇聯軍隊進入中國東北，8月15日日本宣布無條件投降，9月2日在東京灣的密蘇里號戰艦上簽署降書，戰爭以軸心國投降、同盟國全面勝利告終。德國與日本的戰時動員體系在這場戰爭中被消耗殆盡，歐洲舊有的帝國秩序亦隨之崩解。
resultEn: The outcome was the total defeat of the Axis and the formation of a new post-war order. In Europe the Normandy and southern French landings from June 1944 opened a second front, the Soviet armies crossed the eastern line into the Baltic coast in August 1944, and between February 1945 the Vistula-Oder offensive broke the front of the German Army Group Centre, reaching the Elbe in March and crossing the Oder into Berlin in April. Hitler killed himself in the underground of the presidential palace on 30 April, Germany surrendered unconditionally at Reims on 8 May, and the country was then occupied in four zones by the United States, the Soviet Union, Britain and France. In Asia and the Pacific the defeats at Midway in June 1942 and Guadalcanal in August of the same year marked the high point of the Japanese offensive, and from 1943 the Americans recovered the Philippines, Burma, the Solomons and the Marianas line by line. In August 1945 the United States dropped atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, Soviet forces entered Manchuria, Japan announced unconditional surrender on 15 August, and the instrument of surrender was signed aboard the battleship Missouri in Tokyo Bay on 2 September, ending the war with the capitulation of the Axis and the complete victory of the Allies. The mobilisation systems of Germany and Japan were exhausted by the conflict, and the old imperial order of Europe collapsed with it.
